_comment: Sector slot-cards for the sector-aware extraction (spec section 3.3).
TAXONOMY: Adarsh's call, 16 Oct 2026 - use the app's EXISTING sector data
(fno_sectors.json via fno.DISPLAY_GROUPS), not a new LLM-built sector_map.
A symbol's card is resolved at config level from its primary display group
COVERAGE: the cheat sheet defines 9 cards. The app has 15 display groups.
Seven map cleanly, two are deliberate approximations (see _mapping_notes),
and six have no card at all - those run universal-only (spec 3.4), because
Adarsh chose the spec's default of adding no new cards beyond the cheat
sheet. Adding a card later is an edit to this file, not a code change.
SLOTS: taken verbatim from the cheat sheet's 'Watch first' bullets. The
spec's three ADD? proposals (ai_revenue_disclosed for IT, capital_ratios
for banks) are NOT included - Adarsh chose the default of none.

_mapping_notes.Financial Services -> nbfcs: Approximate, accepted by Adarsh. The cheat sheet's NBFC card (AUM growth, disbursements, cost of funds) fits Bajaj Finance/Shriram/Chola well but is a loose fit for the capital-markets and insurance names that also sit in this group (CDSL, BSE, ANGELONE). Those slots return NOT_GIVEN for such names rather than being forced.
_mapping_notes.Consumer Services -> value_retail: Approximate, accepted by Adarsh. The cheat sheet's retail card explicitly names DMart and Trent, which are in this group; hotels/travel names in the same group will mostly return NOT_GIVEN on store-count and SSG slots.
_mapping_notes.banks_include_psu: PSU banks use the private-bank card (same metrics), with bank_type recorded as PSU metadata. Adarsh confirmed 16 Oct 2026. Derived from 'PSU Bank' appearing in fno.sectors_of(symbol).
_mapping_notes.conglomerates: One primary sector only (fno.display_groups_of()[0]); no per-segment slot extraction in v1. Reliance resolves to Energy and therefore runs universal-only.

slots.label: CC revenue growth (QoQ)
slots.capture: Constant-currency revenue growth quarter on quarter. The rupee figure moves with the exchange rate; CC is the real demand signal.

slots.label: CC revenue growth (YoY)
slots.capture: Constant-currency revenue growth year on year.

slots.label: TCV / deal wins
slots.capture: Total contract value of deal wins, with its currency.

slots.label: Book-to-bill
slots.capture: Book-to-bill ratio - whether future revenue is being booked faster than current revenue is delivered.

slots.label: EBIT margin
slots.capture: Operating (EBIT) margin as stated.

slots.label: EBIT margin vs guided band
slots.capture: The company's own margin band if stated, and management's reason for any drift (wage hikes, pricing, acquisitions).

slots.label: Attrition (LTM)
slots.capture: Last-twelve-months attrition rate.

slots.label: Net headcount adds
slots.capture: Net additions to headcount in the quarter.

slots.label: FY guidance band
slots.capture: Full-year guidance band where the company guides (Infosys, HCLTech); a shift in the band outweighs the quarter.

slots.label: NII
slots.capture: Net interest income.

slots.label: NIM
slots.capture: Net interest margin, as stated.

slots.label: NIM direction
slots.capture: Which way NIM moved and why - direction matters more than the level.

slots.label: GNPA
slots.capture: Gross non-performing assets ratio.

slots.label: NNPA
slots.capture: Net non-performing assets ratio.

slots.label: Slippages
slots.capture: Fresh bad loans in the quarter.

slots.label: Credit cost
slots.capture: Credit cost, in bps or absolute, as stated.

slots.label: Provision coverage
slots.capture: Provision coverage ratio.

slots.label: Loan growth
slots.capture: Advances growth; note the basis stated.

slots.label: Deposit growth
slots.capture: Deposit growth; loans growing much faster than deposits squeezes NIM later.

slots.label: CASA share
slots.capture: Current and savings account share of deposits - deposit quality.

slots.label: Fee income growth
slots.capture: Fee income growth, the second and less rate-sensitive engine.

slots.label: Ex-one-off numbers
slots.capture: Underlying growth excluding one-offs where management discloses it (e.g. an FCNR(B) swap window). The cheat sheet's instruction is to always ask for the ex-one-off numbers.

slots.label: Pre-result business update
slots.capture: Whether the call references the earlier provisional deposits/advances update filed before results.

slots.label: AUM growth
slots.capture: Assets under management growth - the volume line.

slots.label: Disbursement momentum
slots.capture: Disbursements in the quarter and their trend.

slots.label: NIM
slots.capture: Net interest margin.

slots.label: Cost of funds
slots.capture: Cost of borrowing - NBFCs borrow to lend, so rising rates squeeze them first.

slots.label: Credit cost
slots.capture: Credit cost, with any segment split management gives.

slots.label: Slippages
slots.capture: Slippages, especially any unsecured and microfinance commentary.

slots.label: Fee income / cross-sell
slots.capture: Fee income and cross-sell metrics where disclosed.

slots.label: Regulatory commentary
slots.capture: RBI/IRDAI rules management names as live margin risks.

slots.label: Volume growth
slots.capture: Volume growth - real demand. Store separately from price growth.

slots.label: Price growth
slots.capture: Price-led growth, which the cheat sheet calls 'rented' growth in an inflationary phase.

slots.label: Gross margin
slots.capture: Gross margin - the raw-material read before cost controls blur it.

slots.label: Rural vs urban
slots.capture: Rural versus urban demand commentary.

slots.label: Base effect
slots.capture: Management's own commentary on base effects distorting the YoY figure.

slots.label: Festive / next quarter
slots.capture: Festive-season and next-quarter commentary; Q3 is the biggest consumption quarter.

slots.label: Segment commentary
slots.capture: Segment-level commentary where the company reports distinct segments (the cheat sheet's instruction for ITC: read segments, not the consolidated headline).

slots.label: Volume growth (wholesale)
slots.capture: Wholesale dispatch volumes and their growth.

slots.label: Retail vs wholesale
slots.capture: Any retail-registration versus wholesale-dispatch commentary.

slots.label: Segment mix
slots.capture: PV / 2W / CV / tractor mix. The cheat sheet warns these cycles move on different clocks and must never be averaged together.

slots.label: Premiumisation / EV mix
slots.capture: SUV and EV share and realisation - premiumisation carries higher realisations.

slots.label: Commodity cost vs price hikes
slots.capture: The margin bridge: steel/aluminium cost movement against price hikes taken.

slots.label: EV investment drag
slots.capture: EV investment drag versus EV scale.

slots.label: Exports / supply chain
slots.capture: Export performance and supply-chain commentary.

slots.label: US generics price erosion
slots.capture: Price erosion in the US base business.

slots.label: One-product cliff
slots.capture: Commentary on a known exclusivity anniversary or single-product cliff. The cheat sheet's trap: a YoY PAT collapse from a lapsed exclusivity is not deterioration.

slots.label: India formulations vs IPM
slots.capture: India formulations growth versus the Indian pharma market, and chronic versus acute mix.

slots.label: Specialty / new products
slots.capture: Specialty and new-product revenue, including biosimilars.

slots.label: R&D / SG&A trajectory
slots.capture: R&D and SG&A trajectory - margin compression from pipeline spend is deliberate, not operational decay.

slots.label: USFDA / regulatory
slots.capture: USFDA or other regulatory headlines attached to the result.

slots.label: Realisation vs benchmark
slots.capture: Realisations against the benchmark (domestic HRC price, LME aluminium) - the company is a price-taker.

slots.label: Spread over input cost
slots.capture: Realisation minus key input cost (coking coal, alumina).

slots.label: EBITDA per tonne
slots.capture: EBITDA per tonne, for steel.

slots.label: Volume growth
slots.capture: Volumes - the one lever management controls.

slots.label: Debt / capex cycle
slots.capture: Debt position and where the company sits in its capex cycle.

slots.label: SSG (or proxy)
slots.capture: Same-store sales growth where given; otherwise the workable proxy of store adds plus revenue per store.

slots.label: Store adds
slots.capture: Stores added in the quarter.

slots.label: Total stores
slots.capture: Total store count.

slots.label: EBITDA margin
slots.capture: EBITDA margin and its movement - value retail lives on thin margins, where 30bps is a big move.

slots.label: Opex / wage pressure
slots.capture: Operating cost and wage-inflation commentary.

slots.label: Store-opening guidance
slots.capture: Forward store-opening plans as stated.

slots.label: E-commerce / quick-commerce drag
slots.capture: E-commerce or quick-commerce losses and their drag.

slots.label: Reporting basis
slots.capture: Standalone versus consolidated, whichever management quotes. The cheat sheet's trap is mixing the two across sources.

slots.label: Order inflow
slots.capture: Order inflow in the quarter - revenue is backward-looking here, orders are the future.

slots.label: Order book
slots.capture: Total order book / backlog.

slots.label: Execution margin
slots.capture: Margin on the order book being executed.

slots.label: Working capital
slots.capture: Working capital position and movement.

slots.label: Private vs govt capex
slots.capture: Private capex versus government capex commentary.
